t5881.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records Muḥammad ibn Ramḥ al-Tujībī, the Egyptian, as trustworthy and firm, from the tenth generation, who died in the year 242.
as: علي بن الحسين بن الجنيد, quoted by al-Mizzī
كان رجلا ، وكان أوثق من ابن زغبة.
He was more trustworthy than Ibn Zughbah.
Trustworthy, though I wrote nothing from him.
ما أخطأ في حديث واحد، ولو كان كتب عن مالك لأثبته في الطبقة الأولى من أصحاب مالك.
He did not err in one hadith. Had he written from Mālik, I would place him in the first class of Mālik's students.
أبو نصر بن ماكولا, quoted by al-Mizzī
Ibn Ḥibbān listed him among the trustworthy transmitters.
ثقة ثبت في الحديث، وكان أعلم الناس بأخبار البلد ووقفه
Trustworthy and precise in hadith. He knew more than anyone about local history and endowments.

t6992.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records Mūsā ibn ʿUqbah ibn Abī ʿAyyāsh al-Asadī, client of the family of al-Zubayr, as trustworthy, a jurist, and an authority on military expeditions, belonging to the fifth generation. It is not established that Ibn Maʿīn declared him weak. He died in the year 41 AH, and it is said after that. The entry notes his source: al-ʿIlal.
as: Trustworthy, a jurist, and an authority on military expeditions
لم يصح أن بن معين لينه
It is not established that Ibn Maʿīn declared him weak.
كان ثقة، قليل الحديث. وفي رواية: وكان ثقة، ثبتا، كثير الحديث.
Ibn Saʿd called him trustworthy with few reports. Another recension calls him trustworthy, firmly reliable and prolific.
Mālik ibn Anas, quoted by al-Mizzī
عليك بمغازي الرجل الصالح موسى بن عقبة، فإنها أصح المغازي.
Use the campaigns compiled by the upright Mūsā ibn ʿUqbah, for they are the soundest.
Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn, quoted by al-Mizzī
كتاب موسى بن عقبة، عن الزهري من أصح هذه الكتب.
Mūsā's book from al-Zuhrī is among the soundest of these books.
Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal, quoted by al-Mizzī
Abū Ḥātim al-Rāzī, quoted by al-Mizzī
Abū Ḥātim added that he was acceptable.
Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn, quoted by al-Mizzī
ثقة، كانوا يقولون في روايته عن نافع فيها شيء
Trustworthy. They had reservations about his reports from Nāfiʿ.
Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn, quoted by al-Mizzī
ليس موسى بن عقبة في نافع مثل مالك، وعبيد الله بن عمر
For Nāfiʿ’s hadiths, Mūsā did not rank with Mālik and ʿUbayd Allāh ibn ʿUmar.
Another version calls him trustworthy and precise and says he transmitted many hadiths.
المفضل بن غسلان الغلابي, quoted by al-Mizzī
وسمعت يحيى بن معين يضعف موسى بن عقبة بعض التضعيف
He heard Ibn Maʿīn describe Mūsā ibn ʿUqbah as somewhat weak.
مصعب بن عبد الله الزبيري, quoted by al-Mizzī
Mūsā and his brothers had an imposing presence and knowledge.
He was trustworthy and transmitted few hadiths.

t7678.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records Yaḥyā ibn Yaʿmar al-Baṣrī, resident and judge of Marw, as trustworthy and eloquent, who used to transmit mursal reports, of the third generation, who died before 100 AH or after, and cites Ibn Mājah.

t7713.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records Yazīd ibn Zurayʿ al-Baṣrī, Abū Muʿāwiyah, as reliable and firmly established, of the eighth generation, who died in the year eighty-two.
as: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd al-Qaṭṭān, quoted by al-Mizzī
لم يكن ها هنا أحد أثبت من يزيد بن زريع.
No one here was a firmer transmitter than Yazīd ibn Zurayʿ.
Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal, quoted by al-Mizzī
He was the foremost in meticulous verification in Basra.
Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal, quoted by al-Mizzī
ما أتقنه وما أحفظه، يا لك من صحة حديث، صدوق متقن.
How accurate and retentive he was, and how sound his hadith. He was truthful and precise.
Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal, quoted by al-Mizzī
كل شيء رواه يزيد بن زريع عن سعيد بن أبي عروبة فلا تبالي أن لا تسمعه من أحد، سماعه من سعيد قديم، وكان يأخذ الحديث بنية.
One need not hear elsewhere anything Yazīd transmitted from Saʿīd ibn Abī ʿArūbah. He heard from him early and took hadith with sincere intent.
Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn, quoted by al-Mizzī
يزيد بن زريع الصدوق الثقة المأمون.
Yazīd ibn Zurayʿ was truthful, trustworthy and dependable.
Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn, quoted by al-Mizzī
Yazīd was more trustworthy than ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz ibn ʿAbd al-Ṣamad al-ʿAmmī.
صحبت يزيد بن زريع أربعين سنة يزداد في كل سنة خيرا.
I accompanied Yazīd ibn Zurayʿ for forty years, and his goodness increased each year.
بشر بن الحارث, quoted by al-Mizzī
كان متقنا حافظا ما أعلم إني رأيت مثله ومثل صحة حديثه.
He was a precise master of hadith. I do not think I saw anyone like him or reports as sound as his.
Abū Ḥātim al-Rāzī, quoted by al-Mizzī
He was reliable, an authority whose reports count as evidence, and a prolific transmitter.
He was one of the most scrupulous of his contemporaries.
Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal, quoted by al-Mizzī
He was the fragrant herb of Basra.
He was trustworthy, an authority and prolific in hadith.
